name: 186. OpenAI-compatible /openai/v1/decisions (openai-compat-decisions)
description: Pins the OpenAI SDK route /openai/v1/decisions (PR #8192): the OpenAI request body reaches every decision model. Every model, gpt-6-luna (a bare name defaults to openai), a Typesafe Jev model and a chat model alike, is answered in OpenAI's response shape rendered from the normalized response (ordered answers, name null for an unnamed question, input/output token usage, and Bifrost's extra_fields as on the other OpenAI routes). The route takes exactly OpenAI's request: Typesafe's criteria and a stray state are rejected by name rather than translated or forwarded. When OpenAI answers with raw responses on (as the harness config sets), its own body is relayed instead, as on the chat route. Fallbacks apply, and the map form and a missing input are rejected.
